findings.finding: BlackRock's reported AUM rose to $15.3 trillion by June 30, 2026, increasing the scale of the institution Fink leads.
Fink's director election retained strong shareholder support, while the executive-compensation advisory vote passed with approximately 65% support and substantial opposition.
The formal succession process reduces the claim that no planning exists, but the absence of a publicly selected successor leaves key-person uncertainty unresolved.
Fink's carried-interest incentive ties personal compensation more directly to private-markets growth, making acquisition integration and valuation outcomes more relevant to governance analysis.
